pages.title: A big school · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Monday morning in a big school in Phoenix. Students walk in the hall with bags. Umar stands near the classroom door. His classmate Tom comes with a notebook. Both boys see a new face in the hall. Umar asks about the new teacher.
“Tom, did you see the new teacher? What does she look like?” says Umar. “Yes! She is tall and thin. She’s about thirty.” says Tom. “What color is her hair?” says Umar.
